formal_title: KSGT Generation IX G9-P50 — Endogenous Proposal-Mechanism Reconstitution, Small-Language-Model Proposer Construction, Proposal–Governance Architectural Separation, Repairable-Support Identification, Capacity–Authority Decoupling, Cross-Proposer Transport & the Minimal Generative Competence Required for Governable Korean Realization
origin_lock: Improve real Korean writing decisions while preserving meaning, target context, and plausible variation; small-model construction is an instrument, not a replacement project identity.
primary_questions: What minimum proposer competence places enough mass in repairable support for downstream governance effects to become identifiable?
Within a frozen proposer family, is there a family-local competence threshold, and is it monotone in capacity under fixed data/objective/tokenizer conditions?
Holding proposer checkpoint, source items, and candidate budget fixed, does KSGT governance change preservation/admissibility/repairability without importing proposer preference as authority?
Do KSGT authority semantics transport across materially different proposer architectures?

decomposition.governor: K(x, C_theta, authority_state) -> admissible set, licensed selection relation, or abstention

SLM_AR.requirement: At least one endogenous checkpoint whose training or finetuning recipe and weights are under KSGT custody.
SLM_AR.capacity_claim_rule: No causal capacity claim if data, objective, tokenizer, or training regime co-varies uncontrolled.

RIVAL_EDIT.preferred_architecture: source-conditioned edit-transducer or retrieval-compositional edit proposer
RIVAL_EDIT.requirement: Must not be merely another decoder-only next-token LM with a different size.
RIVAL_EDIT.purpose: Test authority-semantic transport, not win a quality leaderboard.

gross_reject_defects: defect requiring global regeneration rather than bounded repair

capacity_threshold.definition: minimum tested capacity condition within one frozen family/training regime that passes PIA
capacity_threshold.nonmonotone_rule: Report passing set/interval; do not force a scalar threshold.

same_proposer_identification.U: same candidate set with proposer-native ordering/selection
same_proposer_identification.K: same candidate set with frozen KSGT preservation/admissibility/plurality/selection/abstention policy

capacity_authority_firewall: Proposer score may order candidates only where KSGT authority licenses that role.
Proposer confidence cannot waive hard preservation.
Larger learned judge does not acquire membership, naturalness, or human-burden sovereignty.
Learned components may propose or estimate but do not silently acquire semantic authority.
Set-valued output remains set-valued when plurality is licensed but ordering is not.
next_actions: Preseal SLM capacity ladder and non-LLM rival.
Audit existing data/Harvest sufficiency before acquiring new data or model weights.
Execute PIA before any renewed burden experiment.
